objective: Implement governed OCR.Space, Google Safe Browsing and urlscan.io adapters while keeping Perspective catalogued until its endpoint contract is verified.

rulesConsidered: External providers are advisory resources, never F00/Guardian/Treasury/ComputeRouter/F06/CAS/F07 authorities.
Safe Browsing is explicitly gated to its documented non-commercial boundary.
urlscan private visibility is the default for privacy safety.
Provider bodies are normalized and bounded rather than mirrored into durable evidence.
Perspective API remains unverified and is not implemented by guesswork.

notes: Only http/https URLs are accepted and embedded URL credentials are rejected.
urlscan submission defaults to private visibility.

changes: Added Safe Browsing threatMatches.find adapter with non-commercial guard.
Added urlscan asynchronous submit/result/poll adapter with private default.
Added deterministic provider tests and .okf documentation.
verificationPlan: Require CI + Team Change Gate before merge.
Do not implement Perspective until current official endpoint/authentication contract is verified.
notes: No live qualification is claimed in this PR.
Safe Browsing integration is not represented as commercial-use suitable.
